observations.why: Present-tense 'is now calibrated' plus completed 'verified' and 'holds' anchor attention on the current settled state of a specific instrument — realis and concrete.
A present-tense framing label organizing what follows; carries present focus but no modality or construal signal of its own.
Names a specific instrument in a present-tense inventory line; concrete artifact, realis state.
Specific calibration value and completed verification against named reference plates — present realis state at concrete construal.
